configurations.name: core-nb
runtimeArgs: D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/flowfile-e2e-nb" && mkdir -p "$D/storage" "$D/user" && FLOWFILE_DB_PATH="$D/ff.db" FLOWFILE_STORAGE_DIR="$D/storage" FLOWFILE_USER_DATA_DIR="$D/user" FLOWFILE_OFFLOAD_TO_WORKER=0 FLOWFILE_KERNEL_GC=0 FLOWFILE_TELEMETRY=0 poetry run flowfile_core --port 63596

configurations.name: shots-worker
runtimeArgs: D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/flowfile-shots" && mkdir -p "$D/storage" "$D/user" "$D/secure" && { [ -f "$D/token" ] || python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))' > "$D/token"; } && FLOWFILE_INTERNAL_TOKEN="$(cat "$D/token")" FLOWFILE_DB_PATH="$D/ff.db" FLOWFILE_STORAGE_DIR="$D/storage" FLOWFILE_USER_DATA_DIR="$D/user" FLOWFILE_SECURE_STORAGE_PATH="$D/secure" CORE_PORT=63610 FLOWFILE_TELEMETRY=0 exec poetry run flowfile_worker --port 63611

configurations.name: shots-worker-team
runtimeArgs: D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/flowfile-shots" && mkdir -p "$D/team-storage" "$D/secure" && { [ -f "$D/token" ] || python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))' > "$D/token"; } && FLOWFILE_INTERNAL_TOKEN="$(cat "$D/token")" FLOWFILE_DB_PATH="$D/ff.db" FLOWFILE_STORAGE_DIR="$D/team-storage" FLOWFILE_SECURE_STORAGE_PATH="$D/secure" CORE_PORT=63610 FLOWFILE_TELEMETRY=0 exec poetry run flowfile_worker --port 63612

configurations.name: shots-core
runtimeArgs: D="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/flowfile-shots" && mkdir -p "$D/storage" "$D/user" "$D/secure" && { [ -f "$D/token" ] || python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))' > "$D/token"; } && FLOWFILE_INTERNAL_TOKEN="$(cat "$D/token")" FLOWFILE_DB_PATH="$D/ff.db" FLOWFILE_STORAGE_DIR="$D/storage" FLOWFILE_USER_DATA_DIR="$D/user" FLOWFILE_SECURE_STORAGE_PATH="$D/secure" FLOWFILE_WORKER_PORT=63611 FLOWFILE_KERNEL_GC=0 FLOWFILE_KERNEL_WARMUP=0 FLOWFILE_TELEMETRY=0 exec poetry run flowfile_core --port 63610
